articles.title: 'Not Satisfied': Trump Keeps Pressure on Iran as Deal Remains Elusive
articles.summary: President Trump says he's 'not satisfied' with the Iran deal, warning strikes could resume. Iran's state TV claimed a draft agreement, but the White House dismissed it as a 'complete fabrication.' Talks continue with no breakthrough.

articles.title: South Africa and Afrikaner Groups Reject U.S. Claim of White 'Emergency'
articles.summary: The Trump administration is raising the refugee cap to admit 10,000 more white Afrikaners, citing a humanitarian emergency. South Africa's government and Afrikaner advocacy groups say the claim is unfounded, with some beneficiaries even returning home.

articles.title: Burnham Accuses Blair of Ignoring Inequality in Heated Labour Debate
articles.summary: Andy Burnham, a potential Labour leadership challenger, says former PM Tony Blair's 5,600-word critique of the government fails to mention inequality. Burnham argues rising inequality is driving voters to political extremes.
